source.text: וַתִּשָּׂ֨א אֹתִ֜י ר֗וּחַ וַתָּבֵ֣א אֹ֠תִי אֶל־שַׁ֨עַר בֵּית־יְהוָ֤ה הַקַּדְמוֹנִי֙ הַפּוֹנֶ֣ה קָדִ֔ימָה וְהִנֵּה֙ בְּפֶ֣תַח הַשַּׁ֔עַר עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וַחֲמִשָּׁ֖ה אִ֑ישׁ וָאֶרְאֶ֨ה בְתוֹכָ֜ם אֶת־יַאֲזַנְיָ֧ה בֶן־עַזֻּ֛ר וְאֶת־פְּלַטְיָ֥הוּ בֶן־בְּנָיָ֖הוּ שָׂרֵ֖י הָעָֽם׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And lifted me [the] Spirit and brought me to [the] gate of [the] house of Yahweh, the east [gate], that faces east; and behold, at [the] entrance of the gate twenty and five men; and I saw in their midst Jaazaniah son of Azzur and Pelatiah son of Benaiah, officials of the people.

en.L: Then the Spirit lifted me and brought me in to the gate of the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the eastern [gate], which faces eastward; and look, at the entrance of the gate [were] twenty-five men, and I saw among them Jaazaniah son of Azzur and Pelatiah son of Benaiah, officials of the people.
en.B: Then the Spirit lifted me up and carried me to the east gate of the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the gate facing east. At its entrance were twenty-five men, and I saw among them Jaazaniah son of Azzur and Pelatiah son of Benaiah, officials of the people.
en.R: Then the Spirit lifted me up and took me to the east gate of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s temple. Twenty-five men were standing at the entrance of the gate. Among them I saw two leaders of the people, Jaazaniah son of Azzur and Pelatiah son of Benaiah.

pt.L: Então o Espírito me levantou e me levou à porta da casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, a oriental, que dá para o oriente; e eis que à entrada da porta [havia] vinte e cinco homens, e vi no meio deles Jaazanias, filho de Azur, e Pelatias, filho de Benaia, oficiais do povo.
pt.B: Então o Espírito me ergueu e me levou à porta leste da casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, a porta que dá para o leste. À sua entrada havia vinte e cinco homens, e vi entre eles Jaazanias, filho de Azur, e Pelatias, filho de Benaia, oficiais do povo.
pt.R: Então o Espírito me ergueu e me levou à porta leste do templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Vinte e cinco homens estavam na entrada da porta. Entre eles vi dois líderes do povo, Jaazanias, filho de Azur, e Pelatias, filho de Benaia.

sw.L: Kisha Roho akaniinua akaniingiza mpaka lango la nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, lile la mashariki, linaloelekea mashariki; na tazama, penye mlango wa lango [walikuwa] watu ishirini na watano, nami nikawaona kati yao Yaazania mwana wa Azuri na Pelatia mwana wa Benaya, maafisa wa watu.
sw.B: Kisha Roho akaniinua akanipeleka mpaka lango la mashariki la nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, lango linaloelekea mashariki. Penye mlango wake walikuwepo watu ishirini na watano, nami nikawaona kati yao Yaazania mwana wa Azuri na Pelatia mwana wa Benaya, maafisa wa watu.
sw.R: Kisha Roho akaniinua akanipeleka mpaka lango la mashariki la hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Watu ishirini na watano walikuwa wamesimama penye mlango wa lango hilo. Kati yao nikawaona viongozi wawili wa watu, Yaazania mwana wa Azuri na Pelatia mwana wa Benaya.

vi.L: Bấy giờ Thần Linh nhấc tôi lên và đem tôi vào cổng nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, là [cổng] phía đông, hướng về phía đông; và kìa, ở lối vào cổng [có] hai mươi lăm người, và tôi thấy giữa họ Gia-a-xa-nia con trai A-xua và Phê-la-tia con trai Bê-na-gia, là các quan chức của dân.
vi.B: Bấy giờ Thần Linh nhấc tôi lên và đem tôi đến cổng phía đông của nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, là cổng hướng về phía đông. Tại lối vào cổng có hai mươi lăm người, và giữa họ tôi thấy Gia-a-xa-nia con trai A-xua và Phê-la-tia con trai Bê-na-gia, là các quan chức của dân.
vi.R: Rồi Thần Linh nhấc tôi lên và đem tôi đến cổng phía đông của đền thờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Có hai mươi lăm người đang đứng ở lối vào cổng. Giữa họ tôi thấy hai người lãnh đạo của dân là Gia-a-xa-nia con trai A-xua và Phê-la-tia con trai Bê-na-gia.

ko.L: 그리고 영이 나를 들어 올려 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집 동쪽을 향한 동문으로 데려가셨다. 보라, 그 문 어귀에 스물다섯 명이 [있었고], 나는 그들 가운데서 백성의 고관들인 앗술의 아들 야아사냐와 브나야의 아들 블라댜를 보았다.
ko.B: 그때 영이 나를 들어 올려 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집 동문, 곧 동쪽을 향한 문으로 데려가셨다. 그 문 어귀에 스물다섯 명이 있었는데, 나는 그들 가운데서 백성의 관리인 앗술의 아들 야아사냐와 브나야의 아들 블라댜를 보았다.
ko.R: 그때 영이 나를 들어 올려 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전 동문으로 데려가셨다. 그 문 입구에 스물다섯 명이 서 있었다. 나는 그들 가운데서 백성의 지도자 두 사람, 곧 앗술의 아들 야아사냐와 브나야의 아들 블라댜를 보았다.

fr.L: Puis l’Esprit m’enleva et m’amena à la porte de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, [la porte] orientale, qui regarde vers l’orient ; et voici, à l’entrée de la porte, [il y avait] vingt-cinq hommes, et je vis au milieu d’eux Yaazania fils d’Azzour et Pelatia fils de Benaya, chefs du peuple.
fr.B: Puis l’Esprit m’enleva et me transporta à la porte est de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, la porte qui regarde vers l’est. À son entrée se tenaient vingt-cinq hommes, et je vis parmi eux Yaazania fils d’Azzour et Pelatia fils de Benaya, chefs du peuple.
fr.R: Puis l’Esprit m’a soulevé et m’a emmené à la porte est du temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Vingt-cinq hommes se tenaient à l’entrée de la porte. Parmi eux, j’ai vu deux dirigeants du peuple, Yaazania fils d’Azzour et Pelatia fils de Benaya.

es.L: Entonces el Espíritu me alzó y me llevó a la puerta de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, la [puerta] oriental, que mira al oriente; y he aquí, a la entrada de la puerta [había] veinticinco hombres, y vi entre ellos a Jaazanías hijo de Azur y a Pelatías hijo de Benaía, príncipes del pueblo.
es.B: Entonces el Espíritu me levantó y me llevó a la puerta oriental de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, la puerta que mira al oriente. A su entrada había veinticinco hombres, y vi entre ellos a Jaazanías hijo de Azur y a Pelatías hijo de Benaía, jefes del pueblo.
es.R: Entonces el Espíritu me levantó y me llevó a la puerta oriental del templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. A la entrada de la puerta había veinticinco hombres. Entre ellos vi a dos dirigentes del pueblo, Jaazanías hijo de Azur y Pelatías hijo de Benaía.

am.L: መንፈስም አነሣኝ፤ ወደ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቤት በር፣ ወደ ምሥራቁ [በር]፣ ወደ ምሥራቅ ወደሚመለከተው አመጣኝ፤ እነሆም፣ በበሩ መግቢያ ሃያ አምስት ሰዎች [ነበሩ]፤ በመካከላቸውም የዓዙርን ልጅ ያእዛንያንና የበናያስን ልጅ ፈላጥያን፣ የሕዝቡን አለቆች አየሁ።
am.B: ከዚያም መንፈስ አንሥቶ ወደ ምሥራቅ ወደሚመለከተው ወደ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቤተ መቅደስ ምሥራቃዊ በር ወሰደኝ። በበሩ መግቢያ ሃያ አምስት ሰዎች ነበሩ፤ በመካከላቸውም የሕዝቡን አለቆች የዓዙርን ልጅ ያእዛንያንና የበናያስን ልጅ ፈላጥያን አየሁ።
am.R: ከዚያም መንፈስ አንሥቶ ወደ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቤተ መቅደስ ምሥራቃዊ በር ወሰደኝ። በበሩ መግቢያ ሃያ አምስት ሰዎች ቆመው ነበር። ከእነርሱም መካከል ሁለቱን የሕዝቡን መሪዎች፣ የዓዙርን ልጅ ያእዛንያንና የበናያስን ልጅ ፈላጥያን አየሁ።

hi.L: तब आत्मा ने मुझे उठाया और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के भवन के पूर्वी फाटक पर ले आया, जिसका मुँह पूर्व की ओर है; और देखो, फाटक के द्वार पर पच्चीस पुरुष [थे], और मैंने उनके बीच अज्जूर के पुत्र याज़न्याह और बनायाह के पुत्र पलत्याह को देखा, जो प्रजा के हाकिम [थे]।
hi.B: तब आत्मा ने मुझे उठाकर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के भवन के पूर्वी फाटक पर पहुँचा दिया, उस फाटक पर जिसका मुँह पूर्व की ओर है। उसके द्वार पर पच्चीस पुरुष थे, और मैंने उनके बीच अज्जूर के पुत्र याज़न्याह और बनायाह के पुत्र पलत्याह को देखा, जो प्रजा के अगुवे थे।
hi.R: तब आत्मा ने मुझे उठाया और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के मंदिर के पूर्वी फाटक पर ले गया। फाटक के द्वार पर पच्चीस आदमी खड़े थे। उनके बीच मैंने प्रजा के दो अगुवों को देखा, अज्जूर के पुत्र याज़न्याह को और बनायाह के पुत्र पलत्याह को।

ru.L: И поднял меня Дух и привёл меня к воротам дома {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, восточным, обращённым на восток; и вот, у входа в ворота — двадцать пять человек, и я увидел среди них Иезанию, сына Азура, и Пелатию, сына Ванеи, князей народа.
ru.B: Тогда Дух поднял меня и перенёс к восточным воротам дома {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, к воротам, обращённым на восток. У входа в них стояли двадцать пять человек, и среди них я увидел Иезанию, сына Азура, и Пелатию, сына Ванеи, вельмож народа.
ru.R: Потом Дух поднял меня и принёс к восточным воротам храма {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}. У входа в ворота стояли двадцать пять человек. Среди них я увидел двух начальников народа — Иезанию, сына Азура, и Пелатию, сына Ванеи.

ja.L: そして霊がわたしを持ち上げ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の家の東の門、東に面している[門]へ連れて行った。するとなんと、門の入り口に二十五人の男がいた。わたしは、彼らの中に、民の長であるアズルの子ヤアザンヤと、ベナヤの子ペラトヤを見た。
ja.B: それから、霊がわたしを持ち上げ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の家の東の門、東に面している門へ運んで行った。その入り口には二十五人の男がいて、その中に、民の高官であるアズルの子ヤアザンヤとベナヤの子ペラトヤが見えた。
ja.R: それから、霊がわたしを持ち上げて、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の神殿の東の門へ連れて行きました。門の入り口には、二十五人の男が立っていました。その中に、民の指導者である二人の人が見えました。アズルの息子ヤアザンヤと、ベナヤの息子ペラトヤです。

uk.L: І Дух підняв мене і привів мене до воріт дому {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, східних, що обернені на схід; і ось — біля входу у ворота [було] двадцять пʼять чоловіків, і я побачив серед них Яазанію, сина Аззура, і Пелатію, сина Бенаї, начальників народу.
uk.B: Тоді Дух підняв мене і переніс до східних воріт дому {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, що обернені на схід. Біля входу в них було двадцять пʼять чоловіків, і серед них я побачив Яазанію, сина Аззура, і Пелатію, сина Бенаї, начальників народу.
uk.R: Тоді Дух підняв мене і переніс до східних воріт храму {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}. Біля входу у ворота стояли двадцять пʼять чоловіків. Серед них я побачив двох провідників народу, Яазанію, сина Аззура, і Пелатію, сина Бенаї.

decisions.choice: the Spirit: God's Spirit, who carries the prophet in the vision (see 8:3)
decisions.reason: See 2:2 and 8:3; in 11:24 it is called "the Spirit of God".

decisions.choice: twenty-five men, officials of the people: leaders of the city
alternatives: the same twenty-five men who bowed to the sun in 8:16
decisions.reason: These men stand at the east gate, where the glory has just stopped (10:19). The number matches 8:16, but the setting and the charge are different: these are officials who give counsel in the city (11:2). Jaazaniah son of Azzur is a different man from Jaazaniah son of Shaphan (8:11). Pelatiah's name means "the LORD rescues", and his sudden death follows in 11:13.

decisions.choice: officials (L, B); leaders (R)
decisions.reason: The settled wording for this word in the prophets: "officials" at Literal and Balanced, "leaders" at Readable.

decisions.choice: oficiais (L, B); líderes (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the sarim (m2) are "oficiais" at Literal and Balanced and "líderes" at Readable, as the English says "officials" and "leaders" (r-en-1). Jeremiah's Literal says "príncipes", but Ezekiel keeps "príncipe" for nasi' (7:27), so Literal says "oficiais" here to keep the two apart.

decisions.choice: Jaazanias, filho de Azur; Pelatias, filho de Benaia
decisions.reason: The names take their usual Brazilian forms, as the shared rules for Ezekiel set them: "Jaazanias" (as 8:11, a different man), "Pelatias", and the fathers "Azur" and "Benaia", the forms Jeremiah 28:1 and 2 Samuel 23:20 give those names in Portuguese.

decisions.choice: Yaazania mwana wa Azuri, Pelatia mwana wa Benaya; maafisa (L, B), viongozi (R)
decisions.reason: The names in the forms of the terms note, with Azuri and Benaya as in the published Jeremiah 28:1 and 1 Chronicles 11:22; this Yaazania is not the son of Shaphan of 8:11. The officials are "maafisa" at Literal and Balanced and "viongozi" at Readable, as the English levels.

decisions.choice: Gia-a-xa-nia con trai A-xua; Phê-la-tia con trai Bê-na-gia
decisions.reason: The forms of the term sheet and of Jeremiah 28:1 (A-xua) and 1 Chronicles 11:22 (Bê-na-gia). This Jaazaniah is not the son of Shaphan of 8:11.

decisions.choice: "앗술의 아들 야아사냐", "브나야의 아들 블라댜"
decisions.reason: The Protestant forms of the names (term sheet; 앗술 as Jeremiah 28:1). This Jaazaniah is not the son of Shaphan of 8:11.

decisions.choice: "고관" (L); "관리" (B); "지도자" (R)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording for sarim, as Jeremiah 38:4.

decisions.choice: "Yaazania fils d'Azzour", "Pelatia fils de Benaya"
decisions.reason: The forms fixed in the term sheet; Yaazania son of Azzur is a different man from Yaazania son of Shaphân in 8:11.

decisions.choice: sarim: "chefs" (Literal, Balanced); "dirigeants" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording for these officials, matching the English officials / leaders.

decisions.choice: "príncipes" (L); "jefes" (B); "dirigentes" (R)
decisions.reason: Human sarim as in the Spanish of Jeremiah, against the English "officials"

decisions.choice: "Jaazanías hijo de Azur", "Pelatías hijo de Benaía"
decisions.reason: Name forms of the term sheet, Benaía as published

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of this chapter
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change; the English spans in this chapter have no Amharic counterpart.

decisions.choice: हाकिम (L); अगुवे (B, R)
decisions.reason: The people's officials (sarim) take the forms Ezra and Nehemiah use for Israel's own leaders: हाकिम at Literal, अगुवे at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: याज़न्याह, अज्जूर, पलत्याह, बनायाह
decisions.reason: The names keep the forms already used in this translation: याज़न्याह as 2 Kings 25:23, अज्जूर and पलत्याह as Nehemiah 10, बनायाह as Ezra 10:25.

decisions.choice: князья народа (L); вельможи народа (B); начальники народа (R)
decisions.reason: The sarim, the officials, in the forms of the Russian Jeremiah and Ezekiel 17:12: "князья" (L), "вельможи" (B), "начальники" (R).

decisions.choice: Иезания, сын Азура; Пелатия, сын Ванеи

decisions.choice: give evil counsel: the advice of the king's officials, probably urging resistance to Babylon
decisions.reason: Officials advised the king on policy. In these years Judah's leaders were urging rebellion against Babylon with help from Egypt, against the LORD's word through Jeremiah (Jeremiah 27:9-15; 37:6-10). decisions.choice: "not near is the building of houses": the time to build houses has not come
alternatives: a question: "Is not the time near to build houses?"
"The houses have not been built lately"
"Have not the houses been newly built?", as the Septuagint reads
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is short and can be read several ways. As a statement it may mean that there is no need to build, since they are safe, or it may answer Jeremiah's letter telling the exiles to build houses because their stay will be long (Jeremiah 29:5). Read as a question, it boasts that the city will soon be rebuilt. Either way it is the voice of men who think the danger is past.

decisions.choice: the city is the pot, and we are the meat: the walls protect us, and we are the choice part
decisions.reason: A cooking pot keeps the meat safe from the fire, and the meat is the valuable part, while the scraps are thrown away. The leaders mean that the city's walls protect them, and that they, not the exiles, are the true people (compare 11:15). The LORD turns the picture against them in 11:7-11, and Ezekiel uses it again in 24:3-14.

decisions.choice: a cooking pot; the meat in it

decisions.choice: the Spirit of the LORD fell upon me: God's Spirit came on him to make him speak
decisions.reason: The Spirit of the LORD came on prophets to make them speak (Numbers 11:25; 1 Samuel 10:10). The verb "fell" is the one used of the LORD's hand in 8:1.

decisions.choice: the things that come up in your spirit: your thoughts and plans
decisions.reason: Here "spirit" is the human mind, as in 20:32 ("what comes up into your spirit"). The LORD knows not only what they say (11:3) but what they intend.

decisions.choice: he said to me: the speaker is the LORD, who speaks through the Spirit
decisions.reason: The one who speaks gives Ezekiel the words "Thus says the LORD", so the voice is the LORD's.

decisions.choice: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} says this (B); This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says (R)
decisions.reason: The settled wording for this formula: "Thus says the LORD:" at Literal, "The LORD says this:" at Balanced, "This is what the LORD says:" at Readable. The message is not set in a second pair of quotation marks: the formula introduces it, as in the prophets' oracles.

decisions.choice: vocês (God to the house of Israel); Assim diz o SENHOR (L, B), É isto que o SENHOR diz (R)
decisions.reason: The LORD speaks to the house of Israel in the plural here and through verses 5-12, so every level says "vocês", as the shared rules for Ezekiel set it for the people or the elders as a group; "tu" is kept for Ezekiel, for one person, and for a city or land addressed as one woman (5:8). The formula with the name alone takes the wording Isaiah 7:7 and Jeremiah 2:2 set.

decisions.choice: CHÚA phán thế này (L); CHÚA phán như vầy (B); Đây là lời CHÚA phán (R)
decisions.reason: The formula with YHWH alone, in the wording of the Isaiah and Jeremiah note; inside the quoted command it takes a colon and no further quotation marks.

decisions.choice: "$DN께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다" (L); "…이렇게 말씀하신다" (B); "…께서 하시는 말씀이다" (R)
decisions.reason: "Thus says the LORD" with the name alone, as published in Isaiah and Jeremiah, keeping "께서" in God's own mouth.

decisions.choice: plural "you" to the house of Israel ("han dicho" / "habéis dicho")
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is plural, so the oracle of 11:5–12 takes plural_you spans

decisions.choice: Roho wa BWANA akaniangukia (L); Roho wa BWANA akanijia (B, R)
decisions.reason: God's Spirit takes the capital "Roho", as the terms note sets it; Literal keeps the Hebrew "fell upon", and Balanced and Readable say "came on", as the English does.

decisions.choice: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यों कहते हैं (L); {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यह कहते हैं (B, R)
decisions.reason: The settled Hindi wording for "Thus says the LORD" in the prophets, as Kings and Isaiah. The speaker is honorific (कहते हैं).

decisions.choice: हे इस्राएल के घराने (L, B); हे इस्राएल के लोगो (R)
decisions.reason: "House of Israel" as Jeremiah 18:6: घराना at Literal and Balanced, लोग at Readable.

decisions.choice: сошёл на меня
decisions.reason: The Spirit "fell" on the prophet: Russian "пал" reads as a fall or a defeat, so Literal too says "сошёл", the verb used for the Spirit coming on someone (m1).

decisions.choice: ruach YHWH "{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の霊がわたしの上に下った" (L), "…わたしに下った" (B, R), with no respect form for the Spirit; ma'alot ruchakhem "あなたがたの霊に浮かぶこと" (L), "心に浮かぶ思い" (B), "何を考えているか" (R).
decisions.reason: The Spirit comes on him to make him speak (m1), and the LORD speaks (m3, 言われた). Ezekiel's own ruach is "心" at B, R as 3:14 (m2).

source.text: הִרְבֵּיתֶ֥ם חַלְלֵיכֶ֖ם בָּעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֑את וּמִלֵּאתֶ֥ם חוּצֹתֶ֖יהָ חָלָֽל׃פ

records.literal_gloss: You have multiplied your slain in this city, and you have filled its streets [with] slain.

en.L: You have increased your slain in this city and filled its streets [with] slain [people].
en.B: You have killed many people in this city and filled its streets with the dead.
en.R: You have killed many people in this city. Its streets are full of dead bodies.

pt.L: Vocês multiplicaram os seus mortos nesta cidade e encheram as suas ruas [de] mortos.
pt.B: Vocês mataram muita gente nesta cidade e encheram as suas ruas de mortos.
pt.R: Vocês mataram muitas pessoas nesta cidade. As ruas dela estão cheias de cadáveres.

sw.L: Mmewazidisha waliouawa wenu katika mji huu na kuzijaza njia zake [kwa] waliouawa.
sw.B: Mmewaua watu wengi katika mji huu na kuzijaza njia zake maiti.
sw.R: Mmewaua watu wengi katika mji huu. Njia zake zimejaa maiti.

vi.L: Các ngươi đã làm cho những kẻ bị giết của các ngươi gia tăng trong thành này, và làm cho các đường phố đầy [xác] những kẻ bị giết.
vi.B: Các ngươi đã giết nhiều người trong thành này và làm cho các đường phố đầy xác chết.
vi.R: Các ngươi đã giết nhiều người trong thành này. Đường phố đầy xác chết.

ko.L: 너희가 이 성읍에서 너희에게 죽임당한 자들을 많게 하였고, 그 거리들을 죽임당한 자들로 채웠다.
ko.B: 너희는 이 성읍에서 많은 사람을 죽였고, 그 거리들을 시체로 가득 채웠다.
ko.R: 너희는 이 성에서 많은 사람을 죽였다. 성의 거리마다 시체가 가득하다.

fr.L: Vous avez multiplié vos morts dans cette ville, et vous avez rempli ses rues de morts.
fr.B: Vous avez tué beaucoup de gens dans cette ville et rempli ses rues de cadavres.
fr.R: Vous avez tué beaucoup de gens dans cette ville. Ses rues sont pleines de cadavres.

es.L: {{plural_you:Han multiplicado|Habéis multiplicado}} {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} muertos en esta ciudad y {{plural_you:han llenado|habéis llenado}} sus calles de muertos.
es.B: {{plural_you:Han matado|Habéis matado}} a mucha gente en esta ciudad y {{plural_you:han llenado|habéis llenado}} sus calles de cadáveres.
es.R: {{plural_you:Han matado|Habéis matado}} a mucha gente en esta ciudad. Sus calles están llenas de cadáveres.

am.L: በዚህች ከተማ የገደላችኋቸውን አበዛችሁ፤ መንገዶቿንም በተገደሉ [ሰዎች] ሞላችሁ።
am.B: በዚህች ከተማ ብዙ ሰዎችን ገድላችኋል፤ መንገዶቿንም በሬሳ ሞልታችኋል።
am.R: በዚህች ከተማ ብዙ ሰዎችን ገድላችኋል። መንገዶቿ በሬሳ ተሞልተዋል።

hi.L: तुमने इस नगर में अपने मारे हुओं को बढ़ाया है, और उसकी गलियों को मारे हुओं से भर दिया है।
hi.B: तुमने इस नगर में बहुत लोगों को मार डाला है और उसकी गलियों को लाशों से भर दिया है।
hi.R: तुमने इस नगर में बहुत लोगों को मार डाला है। उसकी गलियाँ लाशों से भरी पड़ी हैं।

ru.L: Вы умножили убитых вами в этом городе и наполнили его улицы убитыми.
ru.B: Вы убили многих в этом городе и наполнили его улицы мёртвыми телами.
ru.R: Вы убили в этом городе много людей. Его улицы полны мёртвых тел.

ja.L: あなたがたはこの都で、あなたがたに殺された者を増やし、その通りを殺された者で満たした。
ja.B: あなたがたはこの都で多くの人を殺し、その通りを死者で満たした。
ja.R: あなたたちは、この都で多くの人を殺した。都の通りは、死体でいっぱいだ。

uk.L: Ви помножили своїх убитих у цьому місті і наповнили його вулиці вбитими.
uk.B: Ви вбили багато людей у цьому місті і наповнили його вулиці мертвими.
uk.R: Ви вбили багато людей у цьому місті. Його вулиці повні мертвих тіл.

decisions.choice: your slain: those killed through your rule
alternatives: the city's war dead, for whose deaths the leaders' policies were to blame
decisions.reason: The word means people killed, usually in war. Here the leaders are said to have killed them, which points to judicial murder and violence in the city (9:9; 22:2-6, 27), though the deaths caused by their failed policies may be included.

decisions.choice: challeikhem "あなたがたに殺された者" (L), "多くの人を殺し" (B, R), as the English.
decisions.reason: Those killed through their rule (m1, uncertain); Literal keeps the noun, B and R make it a verb as the English.

source.text: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּֽה־אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִה֒ חַלְלֵיכֶם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שַׂמְתֶּ֣ם בְּתוֹכָ֔הּ הֵ֥מָּה הַבָּשָׂ֖ר וְהִ֣יא הַסִּ֑יר וְאֶתְכֶ֖ם הוֹצִ֥יא מִתּוֹכָֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore thus says [the] Lord Yahweh: Your slain whom you have put in its midst, they [are] the meat, and it [is] the pot; but you, bring out from its midst.

en.L: Therefore thus says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}: Your slain whom you have laid in its midst, they [are] the meat, and this [city is] the pot; but you [I will] bring out from its midst.
en.B: Therefore the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says this: The dead you have laid in the city are the meat, and this city is the pot; but you I will take out of it.
en.R: So this is what the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says: The people you have killed and left in the city are the meat, and the city is the pot. But you will not stay in it. I will take you out.

pt.L: Portanto assim diz o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}: Os mortos de vocês, que vocês deixaram no meio dela, eles [são] a carne, e esta [cidade é] a panela; mas a vocês [eu] tirarei do meio dela.
pt.B: Portanto assim diz o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}: Os mortos que vocês deixaram na cidade são a carne, e esta cidade é a panela; mas a vocês eu tirarei dela.
pt.R: Por isso é isto que o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}} diz: As pessoas que vocês mataram e deixaram na cidade são a carne, e a cidade é a panela. Mas vocês não vão ficar nela. Eu vou tirar vocês de lá.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Waliouawa wenu mliowalaza katikati yake, hao [ndio] nyama, na huu [mji ndio] chungu; lakini ninyi [nitawatoa] katikati yake.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo hivi ndivyo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Wafu mliowalaza katika mji ndio nyama, na mji huu ndio chungu; lakini ninyi nitawatoa ndani yake.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo hili ndilo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} analosema: Watu mliowaua na kuwaacha katika mji ndio nyama, na mji ndio chungu. Lakini ninyi hamtabaki ndani yake. Nitawatoa nje.

vi.L: Vì vậy, Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: Những kẻ bị giết của các ngươi mà các ngươi đã đặt giữa thành, chúng [là] thịt, và [thành] này [là] cái nồi; nhưng các ngươi, [{{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ] đem ra khỏi giữa nó.
vi.B: Vì thế, Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: Những người chết mà các ngươi bỏ lại trong thành mới là thịt, còn thành này là cái nồi; nhưng các ngươi thì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đem ra khỏi thành.
vi.R: Vậy, đây là lời Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: Những người các ngươi đã giết và bỏ lại trong thành mới là thịt, còn thành là cái nồi. Nhưng các ngươi sẽ không được ở lại trong đó. Ta sẽ đem các ngươi ra ngoài.

ko.L: 그러므로 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 너희가 그 가운데 눕혀 놓은 너희에게 죽임당한 자들, 그들이 고기이고 이 [성읍은] 가마솥이다. 그러나 너희는 [내가] 그 가운데서 끌어내겠다.
ko.B: 그러므로 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 너희가 성읍 안에 눕혀 놓은 시체들이 고기이고, 이 성읍은 가마솥이다. 그러나 너희는 내가 그 안에서 끌어내겠다.
ko.R: 그러므로 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 너희가 죽여서 성안에 버려 둔 사람들이 고기이고, 이 성은 가마솥이다. 그러나 너희는 이 성에 남아 있지 못할 것이다. 내가 너희를 끌어내겠다.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi ainsi parle le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : Vos morts que vous avez placés au milieu d’elle, ce [sont] eux la viande, et elle [est] la marmite ; mais vous, [je vous] ferai sortir du milieu d’elle.
fr.B: C’est pourquoi le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} dit ceci : Les morts que vous avez laissés dans la ville, ce sont eux la viande, et cette ville est la marmite ; mais vous, je vous en ferai sortir.
fr.R: Alors voici ce que dit le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : Les gens que vous avez tués et laissés dans la ville, ce sont eux la viande, et la ville est la marmite. Mais vous, vous n’y resterez pas. Je vous en ferai sortir.

es.L: Por tanto, así dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: {{plural_you:Sus|Vuestros}} muertos, los que {{plural_you:han puesto|habéis puesto}} en medio de ella, ellos [son] la carne, y esta [ciudad es] la olla; pero a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} [los] sacaré de en medio de ella.
es.B: Por eso el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} dice esto: Los muertos que {{plural_you:han dejado|habéis dejado}} en la ciudad son la carne, y esta ciudad es la olla; pero a {{plural_you:ustedes los|vosotros os}} sacaré de ella.
es.R: Por eso, esto es lo que dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: La gente que {{plural_you:han matado|habéis matado}} y dejado en la ciudad es la carne, y la ciudad es la olla. Pero {{plural_you:ustedes no se quedarán|vosotros no os quedaréis}} en ella. Yo {{plural_you:los|os}} sacaré.

am.L: ስለዚህ ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ በመካከሏ ያኖራችኋቸው የገደላችኋቸው እነርሱ ሥጋው [ናቸው]፤ እርሷም ድስቱ [ናት]፤ እናንተን ግን ከመካከሏ [አወጣችኋለሁ]።
am.B: ስለዚህ ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ በከተማዪቱ ውስጥ ያጋደማችኋቸው ሬሳዎች ሥጋው ናቸው፤ ይህችም ከተማ ድስቱ ናት፤ እናንተን ግን ከእርሷ አወጣችኋለሁ።
am.R: ስለዚህ ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ ገድላችሁ በከተማዪቱ የተዋችኋቸው ሰዎች ሥጋው ናቸው፤ ከተማዪቱም ድስቱ ናት። እናንተ ግን በውስጧ አትቀሩም፤ እኔ አወጣችኋለሁ።

hi.L: इसलिए प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} यों कहते हैं: तुम्हारे मारे हुए, जिन्हें तुमने उसके बीच डाल दिया है, वे मांस [हैं], और यह [नगर] हंडा [है]; पर तुम्हें [मैं] उसके बीच से निकाल ले जाऊँगा।
hi.B: इसलिए प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} यह कहते हैं: जिन मरे हुओं को तुमने नगर में डाल दिया है, वे ही मांस हैं, और यह नगर हंडा है; पर तुम्हें मैं उसमें से निकाल ले जाऊँगा।
hi.R: इसलिए प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} यह कहते हैं: जिन लोगों को तुमने मारकर नगर में छोड़ दिया है, वे ही मांस हैं, और यह नगर हंडा है। पर तुम इसमें नहीं रहोगे। मैं तुम्हें इसमें से निकाल ले जाऊँगा।

ru.L: Поэтому так говорит Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: Ваши убитые, которых вы положили посреди него, они — мясо, а он — котёл; а вас [{{deity_pronoun:я|Я}}] выведу из него.
ru.B: Поэтому так говорит Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: Убитые, которых вы оставили в городе, — это мясо, а город — котёл; а вас {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} выведу из него.
ru.R: Поэтому вот что говорит Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: Люди, которых вы убили и оставили в городе, — это мясо, а город — котёл. Но вы в нём не останетесь. Я выведу вас оттуда.

ja.L: それゆえ、{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。あなたがたがそのただ中に置いた、あなたがたに殺された者、彼らが肉であり、この[都]が鍋である。しかし、あなたがたを[わたしは]そのただ中から連れ出す。
ja.B: それゆえ、{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。あなたがたが都の中に横たえた死者こそが肉であり、この都が鍋である。しかし、あなたがたは、わたしがそこから連れ出す。
ja.R: だから、{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。あなたたちが殺して都に残した人々が肉で、都が鍋なのだ。しかし、あなたたちは都にとどまることはない。わたしが、あなたたちを連れ出す。

uk.L: Тому так говорить Владика {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}: Ваші вбиті, яких ви поклали посеред нього, — вони мʼясо, а воно — казан; а вас [{{deity_pronoun:я|Я}}] виведу з нього.
uk.B: Тому так говорить Владика {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}: Убиті, яких ви поклали в місті, — це мʼясо, а це місто — казан; а вас {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} виведу з нього.
uk.R: Тож так говорить Владика {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}: Люди, яких ви вбили й залишили в місті, — це мʼясо, а місто — казан. Але ви в ньому не залишитеся. Я виведу вас звідти.

decisions.choice: the slain are the meat and the city the pot: the only ones who stay in the "pot" are the dead
decisions.reason: The LORD takes up the leaders' saying from 11:3. The city will hold only the bodies of those they killed. The leaders themselves will not be kept safe inside it; they will be taken out to be judged (11:9-11).

decisions.choice: bring out: the verb is a bare form, read as "I will bring out"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew form can be read as an infinitive used for a command or statement; many manuscripts and the ancient versions read "I will bring out", which matches 11:9.

decisions.choice: Thus says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} (L); the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says this (B); this is what the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says (R)
decisions.reason: The settled wording for this formula with "the Lord GOD", as in Isaiah and Jeremiah.

decisions.choice: But you will not stay in it
alternatives: but you I will bring out
decisions.reason: Readable spells out what being taken out of the pot means for the leaders (m1).

decisions.choice: "ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦" at every level
decisions.reason: The messenger formula keeps one wording through Ezekiel (the terms list); Readable keeps it too, since "እንዲህ ይላል" is already plain. Where the English Readable says "Tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says", Readable has "ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ እንደሚል ንገራቸው፦".

decisions.choice: प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}}
decisions.reason: "The Lord GOD" (Adonai YHWH) is प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}}, as Psalms, Kings and Isaiah: प्रभु is Adonai, and the name stands in the setting span as परमेश्वर so that "Lord" is not said twice. The formula follows the "Thus says the LORD" pattern (यों कहते हैं at L, यह कहते हैं at B and R).

decisions.choice: Так говорит Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} (L, B); Вот что говорит Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} (R)
decisions.reason: The prophets note's wording for "Thus says the LORD" with "the Lord GOD" (Adonai YHWH) as Isaiah and Jeremiah: "Владыка" for Adonai, the divine name in its setting, inflected inside each option.

decisions.choice: hotsi' "[わたしは]…連れ出す" (L), "わたしが…連れ出す" (B, R): the bare verb read as God's first person, as the English.
decisions.reason: The verb form is uncertain (m2); the only ones who stay in the 'pot' are the dead (m1).

source.text: חֶ֖רֶב יְרֵאתֶ֑ם וְחֶ֨רֶב֙ אָבִ֣יא עֲלֵיכֶ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: A sword you have feared, and a sword I will bring upon you, declares [the] Lord Yahweh.

en.L: A sword you have feared, and a sword I will bring upon you, declares the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: You fear the sword, and the sword is what I will bring against you, declares the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: You are afraid of war, so I will bring war against you, says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}.

pt.L: A espada vocês temeram, e a espada trarei sobre vocês, declara o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}.
pt.B: Vocês têm medo da espada, e é a espada que trarei contra vocês, declara o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}.
pt.R: Vocês têm medo da guerra, por isso vou trazer a guerra contra vocês, diz o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}.

sw.L: Upanga mmeuogopa, na upanga nitauleta juu yenu, asema Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Mnaogopa upanga, na upanga ndio nitakaouleta dhidi yenu, asema Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Mnaogopa vita, kwa hiyo nitaleta vita dhidi yenu, anasema Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Gươm các ngươi đã sợ, và gươm {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đem đến trên các ngươi, Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.B: Các ngươi sợ gươm, thì chính gươm {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đem đến nghịch cùng các ngươi, Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.R: Các ngươi sợ chiến tranh, nên {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đem chiến tranh đến trên các ngươi, Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.

ko.L: 너희가 칼을 두려워하였으니, 내가 너희에게 칼을 가져오겠다. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 선언이다.
ko.B: 너희가 칼을 두려워하니, 내가 바로 그 칼을 너희에게 가져오겠다. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 말이다.
ko.R: 너희가 전쟁을 두려워하니, 내가 너희에게 전쟁을 일으키겠다. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 말이다.

fr.L: L’épée, vous l’avez craint, et l’épée, je la ferai venir sur vous, déclare le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Vous avez peur de l’épée, eh bien, c’est l’épée que je ferai venir contre vous, déclare le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Vous avez peur de la guerre, alors je ferai venir la guerre contre vous, dit le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}.

es.L: La espada {{plural_you:han temido|habéis temido}}, y la espada traeré sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, declara el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}.
es.B: {{plural_you:Ustedes temen|Vosotros teméis}} la espada, y la espada es lo que traeré contra {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, afirma el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}.
es.R: {{plural_you:Ustedes tienen|Vosotros tenéis}} miedo de la guerra, así que traeré la guerra contra {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}.

am.L: ሰይፍን ፈርታችኋል፤ ሰይፍንም አመጣባችኋለሁ፣ ይላል ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።
am.B: ሰይፍን ትፈራላችሁ፤ የማመጣባችሁም ሰይፍን ነው፣ ይላል ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።
am.R: ጦርነትን ትፈራላችሁ፤ ስለዚህ ጦርነትን አመጣባችኋለሁ፣ ይላል ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።

hi.L: तलवार से तुम डरे हो, और तलवार ही मैं तुम पर लाऊँगा, प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है।
hi.B: तुम तलवार से डरते हो, और तलवार ही मैं तुम पर ले आऊँगा, प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है।
hi.R: तुम युद्ध से डरते हो, इसलिए मैं तुम पर युद्ध ही लाऊँगा, प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} कहते हैं।

ru.L: Меча вы боялись, и меч {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} наведу на вас, — слово Владыки {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.B: Вы боитесь меча — и меч {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} наведу на вас, — говорит Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.
ru.R: Вы боитесь войны — вот {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} и пошлю на вас войну, — говорит Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.

ja.L: あなたがたは剣を恐れた。その剣を、わたしはあなたがたの上にもたらす――{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}の言葉――。
ja.B: あなたがたは剣を恐れている。その剣を、わたしはあなたがたに臨ませる、と{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}は告げる。
ja.R: あなたたちは戦争を恐れている。だから、わたしはあなたたちに戦争を送る、と{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}は言う。

uk.L: Меча ви боялися, і меч {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} наведу на вас, говорить Владика {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}.
uk.B: Ви боїтеся меча, і саме меч {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} наведу на вас, говорить Владика {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}.
uk.R: Ви боїтеся війни, тож {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} наведу на вас війну, каже Владика {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}.

decisions.choice: a sword: war and death in battle
decisions.reason: They trusted the city walls to keep them from the sword; what they feared will come on them.

decisions.choice: war; says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}
decisions.reason: Readable says "war" for the sword, as the Jeremiah table does in the list "sword, famine and pestilence". "Says the Lord GOD" is the settled Readable wording for this formula.

decisions.choice: ne'um Adonai YHWH: "déclare le Seigneur DIEU" (Literal, Balanced); "dit le Seigneur DIEU" (Readable), for the whole book
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording, as the published Kings, Isaiah and Jeremiah.

decisions.choice: "ይላል ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}" after the words, at every level
decisions.reason: The prophetic signature "declares the Lord GOD" (neʾum) closes the saying, as in Jeremiah; Amharic "ይላል" serves for both "declares" and the English Readable "says", so the wording is the same at every level.

decisions.choice: प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है (L, B); प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} कहते हैं (R)
decisions.reason: The settled Hindi wording for "declares the LORD" (neum) in the prophets, here with "the Lord GOD". Readable says युद्ध for the sword, as the English says "war".

decisions.choice: — слово Владыки {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} (L); — говорит Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: The prophets note's wording for "declares the Lord GOD" (neum Adonai YHWH), as Jeremiah: the noun "слово" at Literal, the verb at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: cherev "剣" (L, B), "戦争" (R), as the triad; ne'um 'adonai YHWH "――…の言葉――" (L), "と…は告げる" (B), "と…は言う" (R).
decisions.reason: The sword means war and death in battle (m1); the Ezekiel formulas of notes/EZK-EZK-1.md.

source.text: וְהוֹצֵאתִ֤י אֶתְכֶם֙ מִתּוֹכָ֔הּ וְנָתַתִּ֥י אֶתְכֶ֖ם בְּיַד־זָרִ֑ים וְעָשִׂ֛יתִי בָכֶ֖ם שְׁפָטִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will bring you out from its midst, and give you into [the] hand of foreigners, and execute against you judgments.

en.L: And I will bring you out from its midst and give you into the hand of strangers, and I will execute judgments against you.
en.B: I will take you out of the city and hand you over to foreigners, and I will carry out judgments against you.
en.R: I will take you out of the city and hand you over to foreigners, and I will punish you.

pt.L: E tirarei vocês do meio dela e entregarei vocês na mão de estrangeiros, e executarei juízos contra vocês.
pt.B: Eu os tirarei da cidade e os entregarei a estrangeiros, e executarei juízos contra vocês.
pt.R: Vou tirar vocês da cidade e entregar vocês a estrangeiros, e vou castigar vocês.

sw.L: Nami nitawatoa katikati yake na kuwatia mkononi mwa wageni, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitatekeleza hukumu juu yenu.
sw.B: Nitawatoa mjini na kuwakabidhi kwa wageni, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitatekeleza hukumu dhidi yenu.
sw.R: Nitawatoa mjini na kuwakabidhi kwa wageni, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitawaadhibu.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đem các ngươi ra khỏi giữa nó, và phó các ngươi vào tay những kẻ ngoại bang, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ thi hành các sự phán xét nghịch cùng các ngươi.
vi.B: Ta sẽ đem các ngươi ra khỏi thành, phó các ngươi vào tay dân ngoại bang, và thi hành các sự phán xét nghịch cùng các ngươi.
vi.R: Ta sẽ đem các ngươi ra khỏi thành và giao các ngươi cho dân ngoại bang. Ta sẽ trừng phạt các ngươi.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 너희를 그 가운데서 끌어내어 낯선 자들의 손에 넘기고, 너희에게 심판을 행하겠다.
ko.B: 내가 너희를 성읍 밖으로 끌어내어 이방인들의 손에 넘기고, 너희에게 심판을 내리겠다.
ko.R: 내가 너희를 성 밖으로 끌어내어 외국 사람들에게 넘겨주고, 너희에게 벌을 내리겠다.

fr.L: Et je vous ferai sortir du milieu d’elle, et je vous livrerai entre les mains d’étrangers, et j’exécuterai contre vous des jugements.
fr.B: Je vous ferai sortir de la ville et je vous livrerai aux étrangers, et j’exécuterai contre vous des jugements.
fr.R: Je vous ferai sortir de la ville et je vous livrerai à des étrangers, et je vous punirai.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:los|os}} sacaré de en medio de ella, y {{plural_you:los|os}} entregaré en mano de extranjeros, y ejecutaré juicios contra {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.B: {{plural_you:Los|Os}} sacaré de la ciudad y {{plural_you:los|os}} entregaré a los extranjeros, y ejecutaré juicios contra {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.R: {{plural_you:Los|Os}} sacaré de la ciudad y {{plural_you:los|os}} entregaré a los extranjeros, y {{plural_you:los|os}} castigaré.

am.L: ከመካከሏም አወጣችኋለሁ፤ በባዕዳንም እጅ አሳልፌ እሰጣችኋለሁ፤ በእናንተም ላይ ፍርዶችን አደርጋለሁ።
am.B: ከከተማዪቱ አውጥቼ ለባዕዳን አሳልፌ እሰጣችኋለሁ፤ በእናንተም ላይ ፍርድ እፈጽማለሁ።
am.R: ከከተማዪቱ አውጥቼ ለባዕዳን አሳልፌ እሰጣችኋለሁ፤ እቀጣችኋለሁም።

hi.L: और मैं तुम्हें उसके बीच से निकालूँगा, और तुम्हें परदेशियों के हाथ में दूँगा, और तुम्हारे विरुद्ध दंड की आज्ञाएँ पूरी करूँगा।
hi.B: मैं तुम्हें नगर से निकालकर विदेशियों के हाथ में सौंप दूँगा, और तुम्हें दंड दूँगा।
hi.R: मैं तुम्हें नगर से निकालकर विदेशियों के हाथ में सौंप दूँगा, और तुम्हें सज़ा दूँगा।

ru.L: И {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} выведу вас из него, и отдам вас в руку чужих, и совершу над вами суды.
ru.B: Я выведу вас из города, отдам вас в руки чужеземцев и совершу над вами суд.
ru.R: Я выведу вас из города и отдам в руки чужеземцев. Я накажу вас.

ja.L: わたしはあなたがたをそのただ中から連れ出し、よそ者の手に渡し、あなたがたに裁きを行う。
ja.B: わたしはあなたがたを都から連れ出して異国の者の手に渡し、あなたがたに裁きを下す。
ja.R: わたしはあなたたちを都から連れ出して、外国人の手に渡す。そして、あなたたちを罰する。

uk.L: І {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} виведу вас з-посеред нього, і віддам вас у руку чужинців, і вчиню над вами суди.
uk.B: Я виведу вас із міста, віддам вас чужинцям і виконаю над вами суди.
uk.R: Я виведу вас із міста, віддам вас чужинцям і покараю вас.

decisions.choice: foreigners: the Babylonians
decisions.reason: The foreigners are the Babylonian army, into whose hands the leaders of Jerusalem fell when the city was taken (2 Kings 25:18-21).

decisions.choice: दंड की आज्ञाएँ पूरी करूँगा
decisions.reason: "Judgments" here are sentences carried out, so Literal says दंड की आज्ञाएँ; Balanced and Readable say the plain sense.

decisions.choice: zarim "よそ者" (L), "異国の者" (B), "外国人" (R), as Isaiah's forms for foreigners; shefatim "裁き" (L, B), "罰する" (R).
decisions.reason: The foreigners are the Babylonians (m1).

source.text: בַּחֶ֣רֶב תִּפֹּ֔לוּ עַל־גְּב֥וּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶשְׁפּ֣וֹט אֶתְכֶ֑ם וִֽידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּֽי־אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: By the sword you will fall; at [the] border of Israel I will judge you; and you will know that I [am] Yahweh.

en.L: By the sword you will fall; at the border of Israel I will judge you, and you will know that I [am] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: You will fall by the sword; I will judge you at the border of Israel. Then you will know that I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: You will be killed in war. I will punish you at the border of Israel. Then you will know that I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

pt.L: Pela espada vocês cairão; na fronteira de Israel eu os julgarei; e vocês saberão que eu [sou] {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.B: Vocês cairão pela espada; eu os julgarei na fronteira de Israel. Então vocês saberão que eu sou {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.R: Vocês serão mortos na guerra. Vou castigar vocês na fronteira de Israel. Então vocês saberão que eu sou {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.

sw.L: Kwa upanga mtaanguka; mpakani mwa Israeli nitawahukumu, nanyi mtajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Mtaanguka kwa upanga; nitawahukumu mpakani mwa Israeli. Ndipo mtajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ndimi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Mtauawa vitani. Nitawaadhibu mpakani mwa Israeli. Ndipo mtajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Các ngươi sẽ ngã dưới lưỡi gươm; tại biên giới Y-sơ-ra-ên {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ xét xử các ngươi, và các ngươi sẽ biết rằng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} [là] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Các ngươi sẽ ngã dưới gươm; {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ xét xử các ngươi tại biên giới Y-sơ-ra-ên. Bấy giờ các ngươi sẽ biết rằng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Các ngươi sẽ bị giết trong chiến tranh. Ta sẽ trừng phạt các ngươi tại biên giới Y-sơ-ra-ên. Khi ấy các ngươi sẽ biết {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 너희는 칼에 쓰러질 것이다. 내가 이스라엘 국경에서 너희를 심판하겠다. 그리고 너희는 내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}인 줄 알 것이다.
ko.B: 너희는 칼에 쓰러질 것이다. 내가 이스라엘 국경에서 너희를 심판하겠다. 그러면 너희는 내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}인 줄 알게 될 것이다.
ko.R: 너희는 전쟁에서 죽을 것이다. 내가 이스라엘 국경에서 너희에게 벌을 내리겠다. 그러면 너희는 내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}인 줄 알게 될 것이다.

fr.L: Par l’épée vous tomberez ; à la frontière d’Israël je vous jugerai, et vous saurez que je [suis] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Vous tomberez par l’épée ; je vous jugerai à la frontière d’Israël. Alors vous saurez que je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Vous serez tués à la guerre. Je vous punirai à la frontière d’Israël. Alors vous saurez que je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

es.L: A espada {{plural_you:caerán|caeréis}}; en la frontera de Israel {{plural_you:los|os}} juzgaré, y {{plural_you:sabrán|sabréis}} que yo [soy] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: {{plural_you:Caerán|Caeréis}} a espada; {{plural_you:los|os}} juzgaré en la frontera de Israel. Entonces {{plural_you:sabrán|sabréis}} que yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: {{plural_you:Morirán|Moriréis}} en la guerra. {{plural_you:Los|Os}} castigaré en la frontera de Israel. Entonces {{plural_you:sabrán|sabréis}} que yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

am.L: በሰይፍ ትወድቃላችሁ፤ በእስራኤል ድንበር እፈርድባችኋለሁ፤ እኔ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንደ ሆንኩ ታውቃላችሁ።
am.B: በሰይፍ ትወድቃላችሁ፤ በእስራኤል ድንበር ላይ እፈርድባችኋለሁ። በዚያን ጊዜ እኔ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንደ ሆንኩ ታውቃላችሁ።
am.R: በጦርነት ትገደላላችሁ። በእስራኤል ድንበር ላይ እቀጣችኋለሁ። በዚያን ጊዜ እኔ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንደ ሆንኩ ታውቃላችሁ።

hi.L: तलवार से तुम गिरोगे; इस्राएल की सीमा पर मैं तुम्हारा न्याय करूँगा, और तुम जान लोगे कि मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} [हूँ]।
hi.B: तुम तलवार से मारे जाओगे; इस्राएल की सीमा पर मैं तुम्हारा न्याय करूँगा। तब तुम जान लोगे कि मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} हूँ।
hi.R: तुम युद्ध में मारे जाओगे। इस्राएल की सीमा पर मैं तुम्हें सज़ा दूँगा। तब तुम जान लोगे कि मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} हूँ।

ru.L: От меча вы падёте; у границы Израиля {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} буду судить вас, и узнаете, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.
ru.B: Вы падёте от меча; у границы Израиля {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} буду судить вас. Тогда вы узнаете, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.
ru.R: Вы погибнете на войне. Я накажу вас у границы Израиля. Тогда вы узнаете, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.

ja.L: あなたがたは剣によって倒れる。イスラエルの国境で、わたしはあなたがたを裁く。そしてあなたがたは、わたしが{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}であることを知る。
ja.B: あなたがたは剣に倒れる。わたしはイスラエルの国境で、あなたがたを裁く。そのとき、あなたがたは、わたしが{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}であることを知るようになる。
ja.R: あなたたちは戦争で殺される。わたしはイスラエルの国境で、あなたたちを罰する。そのとき、あなたたちは、わたしが{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}であることを知るようになる。

uk.L: Від меча ви впадете; на кордоні Ізраїлю {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} суджу вас, і ви пізнаєте, що {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}.
uk.B: Ви впадете від меча; {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} суджу вас на кордоні Ізраїлю. Тоді ви пізнаєте, що {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}.
uk.R: Ви загинете на війні. Я покараю вас на кордоні Ізраїлю. Тоді ви пізнаєте, що {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}.

decisions.choice: at the border of Israel: away from the city, at the edge of the land
decisions.reason: When Jerusalem fell, King Zedekiah's sons and the city's leading men were taken to the king of Babylon at Riblah, in the land of Hamath at the northern edge of Israel's land, and killed there (2 Kings 25:6-7, 18-21; Jeremiah 52:9-10, 24-27; compare Numbers 34:8). The leaders who thought the city would protect them died outside it.

decisions.choice: you will know that I am the LORD: the refrain of the book (see 6:7)
decisions.reason: See 6:7.

decisions.choice: You will be killed in war
alternatives: By the sword you will fall
decisions.reason: Readable says "war" for "sword", as in 11:8.

decisions.choice: तुम जान लोगे कि मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} [हूँ] (L); तब तुम जान लोगे कि मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} हूँ (B, R)
decisions.reason: Ezekiel's refrain has one wording at each level, as 1 Kings 20:13: जान लोगे. Literal brackets हूँ, which Hebrew leaves unsaid.

decisions.choice: и узнаете, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} (L); Тогда вы узнаете, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: Ezekiel's refrain in one wording per level, as Isaiah 45:3 and 49:23: the dash stands for the missing "am", so Literal needs no brackets; "узнаете" rather than the Slavonic-sounding "познаете".

decisions.choice: gevul Yisra'el "イスラエルの国境" at every level; the recognition formula as notes/EZK-EZK-1.md.
decisions.reason: Away from the city, at the edge of the land (m1).

source.text: הִ֗יא לֹֽא־תִהְיֶ֤ה לָכֶם֙ לְסִ֔יר וְאַתֶּ֛ם תִּהְי֥וּ בְתוֹכָ֖הּ לְבָשָׂ֑ר אֶל־גְּב֥וּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶשְׁפֹּ֥ט אֶתְכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: It will not be for you a pot, and you will not be in its midst meat; at [the] border of Israel I will judge you.

en.L: This [city] will not be for you a pot, and you will not be in its midst [as] meat; at the border of Israel I will judge you.
en.B: This city will not be your pot, and you will not be the meat inside it. I will judge you at the border of Israel.
en.R: This city will not protect you as a pot protects the meat inside it. I will punish you at the border of Israel.

pt.L: Esta [cidade] não será para vocês uma panela, nem vocês serão no meio dela [a] carne; na fronteira de Israel eu os julgarei.
pt.B: Esta cidade não será a panela de vocês, e vocês não serão a carne dentro dela. Eu os julgarei na fronteira de Israel.
pt.R: Esta cidade não vai proteger vocês como a panela protege a carne que está dentro dela. Vou castigar vocês na fronteira de Israel.

sw.L: Huu [mji] hautakuwa chungu kwenu, wala ninyi hamtakuwa [kama] nyama katikati yake; mpakani mwa Israeli nitawahukumu.
sw.B: Mji huu hautakuwa chungu chenu, wala ninyi hamtakuwa nyama ndani yake. Nitawahukumu mpakani mwa Israeli.
sw.R: Mji huu hautawalinda kama chungu kinavyoilinda nyama iliyomo ndani yake. Nitawaadhibu mpakani mwa Israeli.

vi.L: [Thành] này sẽ không là cái nồi cho các ngươi, và các ngươi sẽ không là thịt ở giữa nó; tại biên giới Y-sơ-ra-ên {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ xét xử các ngươi.
vi.B: Thành này sẽ không là cái nồi của các ngươi, và các ngươi sẽ không là thịt ở trong đó. Ta sẽ xét xử các ngươi tại biên giới Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Thành này sẽ không che chở các ngươi như cái nồi che chở thịt ở trong nó. Ta sẽ trừng phạt các ngươi tại biên giới Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 이 [성읍은] 너희에게 가마솥이 되지 않고, 너희는 그 가운데서 고기가 되지 않을 것이다. 내가 이스라엘 국경에서 너희를 심판하겠다.
ko.B: 이 성읍은 너희의 가마솥이 되지 않고, 너희는 그 안의 고기가 되지 않을 것이다. 내가 이스라엘 국경에서 너희를 심판하겠다.
ko.R: 가마솥이 그 안의 고기를 지켜 주듯이 이 성이 너희를 지켜 주지는 않을 것이다. 내가 이스라엘 국경에서 너희에게 벌을 내리겠다.

fr.L: Elle ne sera pas pour vous une marmite, et vous ne serez pas au milieu d’elle [comme] la viande ; à la frontière d’Israël je vous jugerai.
fr.B: Cette ville ne sera pas votre marmite, et vous ne serez pas la viande qui est dedans. Je vous jugerai à la frontière d’Israël.
fr.R: Cette ville ne vous protégera pas comme une marmite protège la viande qui est dedans. Je vous punirai à la frontière d’Israël.

es.L: Esta [ciudad] no será para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} la olla, ni {{plural_you:ustedes serán|vosotros seréis}} en medio de ella la carne; en la frontera de Israel {{plural_you:los|os}} juzgaré.
es.B: Esta ciudad no será {{plural_you:su olla|vuestra olla}}, ni {{plural_you:ustedes serán|vosotros seréis}} la carne dentro de ella. {{plural_you:Los|Os}} juzgaré en la frontera de Israel.
es.R: Esta ciudad no {{plural_you:los|os}} protegerá como una olla protege la carne que tiene dentro. {{plural_you:Los|Os}} castigaré en la frontera de Israel.

am.L: ይህች [ከተማ] ድስት አትሆናችሁም፤ እናንተም በመካከሏ ሥጋ [ሆናችሁ] አትኖሩም፤ በእስራኤል ድንበር እፈርድባችኋለሁ።
am.B: ይህች ከተማ ድስታችሁ አትሆንም፤ እናንተም በውስጧ ያለ ሥጋ አትሆኑም። በእስራኤል ድንበር ላይ እፈርድባችኋለሁ።
am.R: ድስት በውስጡ ያለውን ሥጋ እንደሚጠብቅ ይህች ከተማ እናንተን አትጠብቃችሁም። በእስራኤል ድንበር ላይ እቀጣችኋለሁ።

hi.L: यह [नगर] तुम्हारे लिए हंडा न होगा, और न तुम उसके बीच मांस होगे; इस्राएल की सीमा पर मैं तुम्हारा न्याय करूँगा।
hi.B: यह नगर तुम्हारा हंडा नहीं बनेगा, और न तुम उसके भीतर का मांस बनोगे। इस्राएल की सीमा पर मैं तुम्हारा न्याय करूँगा।
hi.R: जैसे हंडा अपने भीतर के मांस को बचाए रखता है, वैसे यह नगर तुम्हें नहीं बचाएगा। इस्राएल की सीमा पर मैं तुम्हें सज़ा दूँगा।

ru.L: Он не будет для вас котлом, и вы не будете посреди него мясом; у границы Израиля {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} буду судить вас.
ru.B: Этот город не будет вашим котлом, и вы не будете мясом в нём. Я буду судить вас у границы Израиля.
ru.R: Этот город не защитит вас, как котёл защищает мясо, которое в нём варится. Я накажу вас у границы Израиля.

ja.L: この[都]は、あなたがたのための鍋とはならず、あなたがたはそのただ中で肉とはならない。イスラエルの国境で、わたしはあなたがたを裁く。
ja.B: この都はあなたがたの鍋とはならず、あなたがたはその中の肉とはならない。わたしはイスラエルの国境で、あなたがたを裁く。
ja.R: 鍋が中の肉を守るように、この都があなたたちを守ることはない。わたしはイスラエルの国境で、あなたたちを罰する。

uk.L: Воно не буде для вас казаном, і ви не будете посеред нього [як] мʼясо; на кордоні Ізраїлю {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} суджу вас.
uk.B: Це місто не буде вашим казаном, і ви не будете мʼясом у ньому. Я суджу вас на кордоні Ізраїлю.
uk.R: Це місто не захистить вас, як казан захищає мʼясо в ньому. Я покараю вас на кордоні Ізраїлю.

decisions.choice: not a pot for you, not the meat inside it: the city will not protect them
decisions.reason: The picture of 11:3 is denied outright: the city will not be their shelter.

decisions.choice: will not protect you as a pot protects the meat
alternatives: will not be a pot for you
decisions.reason: Readable says what the picture means (11:3 m2).

decisions.choice: Readable explains the image: "鍋が中の肉を守るように、この都があなたたちを守ることはない", as the English R.
decisions.reason: The city will not protect them (m1).

source.text: וִֽידַעְתֶּם֙ כִּֽי־אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר בְּחֻקַּי֙ לֹ֣א הֲלַכְתֶּ֔ם וּמִשְׁפָּטַ֖י לֹ֣א עֲשִׂיתֶ֑ם וּֽכְמִשְׁפְּטֵ֧י הַגּוֹיִ֛ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר סְבִיבוֹתֵיכֶ֖ם עֲשִׂיתֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will know that I [am] Yahweh, in whose statutes you have not walked, and my judgments you have not done; but according to the judgments of the nations that [are] around you, you have acted.

en.L: And you will know that I [am] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, in whose statutes you have not walked, and whose judgments you have not done; but according to the judgments of the nations that [are] around you, you have acted."
en.B: Then you will know that I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. You have not followed {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} statutes or carried out {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} rulings; instead you have acted by the rulings of the nations around you."
en.R: Then you will know that I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. You did not live by {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} laws or obey {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} rules. Instead, you followed the rules of the nations around you."

pt.L: E vocês saberão que eu [sou] {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, em cujos estatutos vocês não andaram, e cujos juízos não praticaram; mas segundo os juízos das nações que [estão] ao redor de vocês agiram."
pt.B: Então vocês saberão que eu sou {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. Vocês não seguiram os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} estatutos nem cumpriram as {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} ordenanças; em vez disso, agiram segundo as ordenanças das nações ao redor de vocês."
pt.R: Então vocês saberão que eu sou {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. Vocês não viveram segundo as {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} leis nem obedeceram às {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} regras. Em vez disso, seguiram as regras das nações ao redor de vocês."

sw.L: Nanyi mtajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ambaye katika kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} hamkuenenda, na hukumu {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} hamkuzitenda; bali mmetenda kulingana na hukumu za mataifa yanayowazunguka."
sw.B: Ndipo mtajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ndimi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Hamkufuata kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} wala hamkuyatimiza maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}; badala yake mmetenda kwa kufuata maagizo ya mataifa yanayowazunguka."
sw.R: Ndipo mtajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Hamkuishi kwa kufuata sheria {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} wala hamkuzitii. Badala yake mlifuata sheria za mataifa yanayowazunguka."

vi.L: Và các ngươi sẽ biết rằng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} [là] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, là Đấng mà các ngươi đã không bước đi theo luật lệ, và đã không làm theo mạng lệnh; nhưng các ngươi đã làm theo các mạng lệnh của các dân tộc chung quanh các ngươi."
vi.B: Bấy giờ các ngươi sẽ biết rằng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Các ngươi đã không sống theo các luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, cũng không thi hành các mạng lệnh của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, nhưng đã làm theo các mạng lệnh của các dân tộc chung quanh."
vi.R: Khi ấy các ngươi sẽ biết {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Các ngươi đã không sống theo các luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, cũng không vâng giữ các quy định của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Thay vào đó, các ngươi đã làm theo các quy định của các dân tộc chung quanh."

ko.L: 그리고 너희는 내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}인 줄 알 것이다. 너희는 내 규례대로 걷지 않았고 내 법도를 행하지 않았으며, 오히려 너희 둘레에 있는 민족들의 법도대로 행하였다."
ko.B: 그러면 너희는 내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}인 줄 알게 될 것이다. 너희는 내 규례를 따르지 않았고 내 법도를 지키지 않았다. 오히려 너희 둘레에 있는 민족들의 법도를 따랐다."
ko.R: 그러면 너희는 내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}인 줄 알게 될 것이다. 너희는 내 법대로 살지 않았고 내 규칙에 순종하지 않았다. 오히려 너희 둘레에 있는 민족들의 규칙을 따랐다."

fr.L: Et vous saurez que je [suis] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, dont vous n’avez pas suivi les prescriptions, et dont vous n’avez pas pratiqué les jugements ; mais selon les jugements des nations qui [sont] autour de vous, vous avez agi. »
fr.B: Alors vous saurez que je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Vous n’avez pas suivi {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} prescriptions ni appliqué {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} ordonnances ; vous avez plutôt agi selon les ordonnances des nations qui vous entourent. »
fr.R: Alors vous saurez que je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Vous n’avez pas vécu selon {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} lois et vous n’avez pas obéi à {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} règles. Au contraire, vous avez suivi les règles des nations autour de vous. »

es.L: Y {{plural_you:sabrán|sabréis}} que yo [soy] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, en cuyos estatutos no {{plural_you:han andado|habéis andado}}, y cuyos decretos no {{plural_you:han cumplido|habéis cumplido}}; sino que conforme a los decretos de las naciones que [están] alrededor de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{plural_you:han actuado|habéis actuado}}».
es.B: Entonces {{plural_you:sabrán|sabréis}} que yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. No {{plural_you:han seguido|habéis seguido}} {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} estatutos ni {{plural_you:han cumplido|habéis cumplido}} {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} normas; en cambio, {{plural_you:han actuado|habéis actuado}} según las normas de las naciones que {{plural_you:los|os}} rodean».
es.R: Entonces {{plural_you:sabrán|sabréis}} que yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. No {{plural_you:vivieron|vivisteis}} según {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} leyes ni {{plural_you:obedecieron|obedecisteis}} {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} normas. En cambio, {{plural_you:siguieron|seguisteis}} las normas de las naciones que {{plural_you:los|os}} rodean».

am.L: እኔ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንደ ሆንኩ ታውቃላችሁ፤ በሥርዓቶቼ አልሄዳችሁም፤ ፍርዶቼንም አላደረጋችሁም፤ ነገር ግን በዙሪያችሁ እንዳሉት ሕዝቦች ፍርዶች አደረጋችሁ።»
am.B: በዚያን ጊዜ እኔ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንደ ሆንኩ ታውቃላችሁ። ሥርዓቶቼን አልተከተላችሁም፤ ደንቦቼንም አልፈጸማችሁም፤ ይልቁንም በዙሪያችሁ ባሉት ሕዝቦች ደንቦች ኖራችሁ።»
am.R: በዚያን ጊዜ እኔ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንደ ሆንኩ ታውቃላችሁ። እናንተ በሥርዓቶቼ አልኖራችሁም፤ ሕጎቼንም አልታዘዛችሁም። ይልቁንም በዙሪያችሁ ያሉትን ሕዝቦች ሕጎች ተከተላችሁ።»

hi.L: और तुम जान लोगे कि मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} [हूँ], जिसकी विधियों पर तुम नहीं चले, और जिसके नियमों का पालन तुमने नहीं किया; पर अपने चारों ओर की जातियों के नियमों के अनुसार तुमने किया है।"
hi.B: तब तुम जान लोगे कि मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} हूँ। तुम मेरी विधियों पर नहीं चले और मेरे नियमों का पालन नहीं किया; बल्कि अपने आस-पास के देशों के नियमों के अनुसार चलते रहे।"
hi.R: तब तुम जान लोगे कि मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} हूँ। तुमने मेरी विधियों के अनुसार जीवन नहीं बिताया और मेरे नियमों को नहीं माना। उलटे, तुम अपने आस-पास के देशों के नियमों पर चले।"

ru.L: И узнаете, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, по чьим установлениям вы не ходили и чьих правил не исполняли, а поступали по правилам народов, которые вокруг вас.»
ru.B: Тогда вы узнаете, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}. Вы не следовали {{deity_pronoun:моим|Моим}} установлениям и не исполняли {{deity_pronoun:моих|Моих}} правил, а поступали по правилам народов, которые живут вокруг вас.»
ru.R: Тогда вы узнаете, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}. Вы не жили по {{deity_pronoun:моим|Моим}} законам и не соблюдали {{deity_pronoun:моих|Моих}} правил. Вы жили по правилам народов, которые вокруг вас.»

ja.L: そしてあなたがたは、わたしが{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}であることを知る。あなたがたは、わたしの定めに歩まず、わたしの掟を行わず、あなたがたの周りにある国々の掟に従って行ってきた。」
ja.B: そのとき、あなたがたは、わたしが{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}であることを知るようになる。あなたがたは、わたしの定めに従って歩まず、わたしの掟を行わず、かえって周りの国々の掟に従って行ってきた。」
ja.R: そのとき、あなたたちは、わたしが{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}であることを知るようになる。あなたたちは、わたしのきまりに従って生きず、わたしのおきてを守らなかった。かえって、周りの国々のおきてに従ってきた。」

uk.L: І ви пізнаєте, що {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, за чиїми постановами ви не ходили і чиїх законів не виконували, а чинили за законами народів, що довкола вас.»
uk.B: Тоді ви пізнаєте, що {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}. Ви не жили за {{deity_pronoun:моїми|Моїми}} постановами і не виконували {{deity_pronoun:моїх|Моїх}} законів, а чинили за законами народів довкола вас.»
uk.R: Тоді ви пізнаєте, що {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}. Ви не жили за {{deity_pronoun:моїми|Моїми}} законами і не слухалися {{deity_pronoun:моїх|Моїх}} правил. Натомість ви жили за правилами народів довкола вас.»

decisions.choice: judgments: rulings and customs; the LORD's judgments set against those of the nations
decisions.reason: The same word is used for the LORD's judgments and for the practices of the nations. Israel was told not to live by the ways of the nations (Leviticus 18:3-4; 2 Kings 17:15). Ezekiel charges them with doing just that (5:7).

decisions.choice: you will know that I am the LORD (see 6:7)
decisions.reason: See 6:7.

decisions.choice: statutes, judgments (L); statutes, rulings (B); laws, rules (R)
decisions.reason: The settled wording of 5:6-7 for these two words. Each level uses the same word for the LORD's rulings and the nations', to keep the contrast.

decisions.choice: the relative clause "in whose statutes you have not walked" becomes main clauses
decisions.reason: An Amharic relative clause would have to come before "እኔ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}" and break the refrain; the charge follows it as three short clauses. Statutes "ሥርዓቶች"; judgments "ፍርዶች" (L), "ደንቦች" (B), "ሕጎች" (R), as Leviticus 18.

decisions.choice: विधियाँ, नियम (every level), as 5:6-7
decisions.reason: Statutes and judgments take the forms of Leviticus 26 (विधियाँ, नियम). The same word नियम is used for the LORD's judgments and the nations', to keep the contrast the English keeps.

decisions.choice: установления, правила (L, B); законы, правила (R)
decisions.reason: The Pentateuch note's words for huqqim and mishpatim. "Правила" serves at every level for both the LORD's rulings and the nations' customs, so the contrast in the Hebrew stays (m1).

decisions.choice: chuqqai "わたしの定め" (L, B), "わたしのきまり" (R); mishpatai "わたしの掟" (L, B), "わたしのおきて" (R), and the nations' mishpatim in the same word.
alternatives: "掟" for chuqqot and "定め" for mishpatim
decisions.reason: The Pentateuch forms (Leviticus 18-19, Deuteronomy 5; notes/EZK-EZK-3.md TORAH TERMS), which chapters 18 and 20 also use; 5:6-7 now uses them too. The LORD's judgments are set against those of the nations (m1). The relative clause "in whose statutes" is made a new sentence at every level.

source.text: וַֽיְהִי֙ כְּהִנָּ֣בְאִ֔י וּפְלַטְיָ֥הוּ בֶן־בְּנָיָ֖ה מֵ֑ת וָאֶפֹּ֨ל עַל־פָּנַ֜י וָאֶזְעַ֣ק קוֹל־גָּד֗וֹל וָאֹמַר֙ אֲהָהּ֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה כָּלָה֙ אַתָּ֣ה עֹשֶׂ֔ה אֵ֖ת שְׁאֵרִ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And it was, as I prophesied, that Pelatiah son of Benaiah died. And I fell on my face and cried out [with] a loud voice and said, Ah, Lord Yahweh! A full end [are] you making of [the] remnant of Israel?

en.L: And it came about, as I was prophesying, that Pelatiah son of Benaiah died. And I fell on my face and cried out with a loud voice and said, "Ah, Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}! Are {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} making a full end of the remnant of Israel?"
en.B: While I was prophesying, Pelatiah son of Benaiah died. Then I fell face down and cried out with a loud voice, "Oh, Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}! Are {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} going to wipe out the remnant of Israel completely?"
en.R: While I was prophesying, Pelatiah son of Benaiah died. I threw myself face down on the ground and shouted, "Oh no, Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}! Are {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} going to destroy everyone left in Israel?"

pt.L: E aconteceu, enquanto eu profetizava, que Pelatias, filho de Benaia, morreu. E caí sobre o meu rosto, e clamei em alta voz, e disse: "Ah, Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}! Estás {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} dando fim completo ao remanescente de Israel?"
pt.B: Enquanto eu profetizava, Pelatias, filho de Benaia, morreu. Então caí com o rosto em terra e clamei em alta voz: "Ah, Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}! Vais acabar de vez com o remanescente de Israel?"
pt.R: Enquanto eu profetizava, Pelatias, filho de Benaia, morreu. Eu me curvei com o rosto no chão e gritei: "Ah, não, Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}! Vais destruir todos os que restaram em Israel?"

sw.L: Ikawa nilipokuwa nikitabiri, Pelatia mwana wa Benaya akafa. Nami nikaanguka juu ya uso wangu, nikalia kwa sauti kuu, nikasema, "Ole wangu, Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}! Je, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unawakomesha kabisa mabaki ya Israeli?"
sw.B: Nilipokuwa nikitabiri, Pelatia mwana wa Benaya akafa. Ndipo nikaanguka kifudifudi nikalia kwa sauti kuu, "Ee Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}! Je, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} utayafutilia mbali kabisa mabaki ya Israeli?"
sw.R: Nilipokuwa nikitabiri, Pelatia mwana wa Benaya akafa. Nikajitupa chini kifudifudi nikapaza sauti, "Hapana, Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}! Je, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} utawaangamiza wote waliobaki katika Israeli?"

vi.L: Và đã xảy ra, khi tôi đang nói tiên tri, thì Phê-la-tia con trai Bê-na-gia chết. Và tôi sấp mặt xuống và kêu lớn tiếng rằng: "Ôi, lạy Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}! Ngài sẽ tận diệt những người sót lại của Y-sơ-ra-ên sao?"
vi.B: Đang khi tôi nói tiên tri, Phê-la-tia con trai Bê-na-gia chết. Bấy giờ tôi sấp mặt xuống và kêu lớn tiếng: "Ôi, lạy Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}! Ngài sẽ tiêu diệt hoàn toàn những người còn sót lại của Y-sơ-ra-ên sao?"
vi.R: Đang khi tôi nói tiên tri, Phê-la-tia con trai Bê-na-gia chết. Tôi sấp mặt xuống đất và kêu lớn: "Ôi, lạy Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}! Ngài sẽ tiêu diệt hết những người còn sống sót trong Y-sơ-ra-ên sao?"

ko.L: 내가 예언하고 있을 때에 브나야의 아들 블라댜가 죽었다. 그래서 나는 얼굴을 대고 엎드려 큰 소리로 부르짖으며 말했다. "아, 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}! 주님께서 이스라엘의 남은 자를 완전히 끝장내시렵니까?"
ko.B: 내가 예언하고 있는 동안에 브나야의 아들 블라댜가 죽었다. 나는 얼굴을 땅에 대고 엎드려 큰 소리로 부르짖었다. "아, 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}! 주님께서 이스라엘의 남은 사람들을 모조리 없애시렵니까?"
ko.R: 내가 예언하고 있는 동안에 브나야의 아들 블라댜가 죽었다. 나는 땅에 엎드려 소리쳤다. "아, 안 됩니다, 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}! 주님께서 이스라엘에 남은 사람들을 다 죽이시렵니까?"

fr.L: Et il arriva, pendant que je prophétisais, que Pelatia fils de Benaya mourut. Et je tombai sur ma face, et je criai d’une voix forte et dis : « Ah ! Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} ! Vas-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} faire une destruction complète du reste d’Israël ? »
fr.B: Pendant que je prophétisais, Pelatia fils de Benaya mourut. Alors je tombai face contre terre et je criai d’une voix forte : « Ah ! Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} ! Vas-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} anéantir complètement le reste d’Israël ? »
fr.R: Pendant que je prophétisais, Pelatia fils de Benaya est mort. Je me suis jeté face contre terre et j’ai crié : « Oh non, Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} ! Vas-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} détruire tous ceux qui restent en Israël ? »

es.L: Y sucedió que, mientras yo profetizaba, Pelatías hijo de Benaía murió. Y caí sobre mi rostro y clamé a gran voz y dije: «¡Ah, Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}! ¿Vas {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} a acabar del todo con el remanente de Israel?».
es.B: Mientras yo profetizaba, Pelatías hijo de Benaía murió. Entonces caí rostro en tierra y clamé a gran voz: «¡Ay, Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}! ¿Vas {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} a exterminar por completo al remanente de Israel?».
es.R: Mientras yo profetizaba, Pelatías hijo de Benaía murió. Me eché con el rostro en tierra y grité: «¡Oh no, Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}! ¿Vas {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} a destruir a todos los que quedan en Israel?».

am.L: ትንቢትም በምናገርበት ጊዜ የበናያስ ልጅ ፈላጥያ ሞተ። እኔም በፊቴ ተደፋሁ፤ በታላቅ ድምፅም ጮኽኩ፤ እንዲህም አልኩ፦ «ወይኔ፣ ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ! የእስራኤልን ቅሬታ ፈጽመህ ታጠፋለህን?»
am.B: ትንቢት እየተናገርኩ ሳለ የበናያስ ልጅ ፈላጥያ ሞተ። እኔም በግንባሬ ተደፍቼ በታላቅ ድምፅ እንዲህ ብዬ ጮኽኩ፦ «ወይኔ፣ ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ! የእስራኤልን ቅሬታ ፈጽመህ ልታጠፋ ነውን?»
am.R: ትንቢት እየተናገርኩ ሳለ የበናያስ ልጅ ፈላጥያ ሞተ። እኔም መሬት ላይ በግንባሬ ተደፍቼ እንዲህ ብዬ ጮኽኩ፦ «ኧረ ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ! በእስራኤል የቀሩትን ሁሉ ልታጠፋ ነውን?»

ru.L: И было, когда я пророчествовал, Пелатия, сын Ванеи, умер. И я пал на своё лицо, и закричал громким голосом, и сказал: «Ах, Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}! Неужели полный конец {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} совершаешь остатку Израиля?»
ru.B: Пока я пророчествовал, Пелатия, сын Ванеи, умер. Тогда я пал лицом на землю и громко воскликнул: «О Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}! Неужели {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} совсем истребишь остаток Израиля?»

ja.L: そして、わたしが預言していると、ベナヤの子ペラトヤが死んだ。わたしは顔を伏せて倒れ、大声で叫んで言った。「ああ、{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}よ。あなたはイスラエルの残りの者を、滅ぼし尽くされるのですか？」
ja.B: わたしが預言している間に、ベナヤの子ペラトヤが死んだ。わたしは顔を伏せて倒れ、大声で叫んだ。「ああ、{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}よ。イスラエルの残りの者を、すっかり滅ぼしてしまわれるのですか？」
ja.R: わたしが預言している間に、ベナヤの息子ペラトヤが死にました。わたしは地面に顔を伏せ、大声で叫びました。「ああ、そんな、{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}よ。イスラエルに残っている人々を、みな滅ぼしてしまわれるのですか？」

decisions.choice: the word of the LORD came to me: a new word within the vision, answering Ezekiel's question
decisions.reason: The formula that begins most of Ezekiel's oracles appears here in the middle of the vision. The answer to 11:13 is that the LORD's people will survive among the exiles, not in Jerusalem.

decisions.choice: The word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} came to me, saying: (L); came to me: (B); {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} gave me this message: (R)
decisions.reason: The settled wording for this formula, from the Jeremiah table. In Ezekiel, the oracle that follows it is not put in quotation marks: as in Isaiah, God's first-person speech in an oracle stands on its own, and only speech quoted within it takes quotation marks. Speech in the visions ("He said to me, ...") is quoted as narrative quotes speech.

decisions.choice: L "... ቃል ወደ እኔ መጣ፤ እንዲህም አለ፦"; B "... ቃል ወደ እኔ መጣ፦"; R "... ይህን መልእክት ሰጠኝ፦"

records.literal_gloss: Son of man, your brothers, your brothers, [the] men of your redemption, and [the] whole house of Israel, all of it, [are those] of whom said [the] inhabitants of Jerusalem, Go far from Yahweh; to us it [is] given, this land, as a possession.

en.L: Son of man, your brothers, your brothers, the men of your redemption, and the whole house of Israel, all of it, [are those] of whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said, "Go far from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; to us this land has been given as a possession."
en.B: Son of man, your brothers, your own brothers, the relatives who have the right to redeem you, and the whole house of Israel, all of them, are the ones of whom the people of Jerusalem have said, "Stay far away from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}! It is to us that this land has been given as a possession."
en.R: Son of man, the people living in Jerusalem have been talking about your relatives, your own family, and about all the other people of Israel in exile. They have said, "Stay far away from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}! The land is ours now. It has been given to us."

pt.L: Filho do homem, os teus irmãos, os teus irmãos, os homens do teu resgate, e toda a casa de Israel, toda ela, [são aqueles] de quem os habitantes de Jerusalém disseram: "Afastem-se {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}; a nós esta terra foi dada como possessão."
pt.B: Filho do homem, os teus irmãos, os teus próprios irmãos, os parentes que têm o direito de te resgatar, e toda a casa de Israel, todos eles, são aqueles de quem os moradores de Jerusalém disseram: "Fiquem longe {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}! É a nós que esta terra foi dada como propriedade."
pt.R: Filho do homem, as pessoas que moram em Jerusalém andam falando dos teus parentes, da tua própria família, e de todo o resto do povo de Israel que está no exílio. Elas dizem: "Fiquem longe {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}! A terra agora é nossa. Ela foi dada a nós."

sw.B: Mwana wa binadamu, ndugu zako, ndugu zako mwenyewe, jamaa walio na haki ya kukukomboa, na nyumba yote ya Israeli, wote kabisa, ndio wale ambao watu wa Yerusalemu wamesema juu yao, "Kaeni mbali na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! Ni sisi tuliopewa nchi hii kuwa milki yetu."
sw.R: Mwana wa binadamu, watu wanaoishi Yerusalemu wamekuwa wakiwasema jamaa zako, ndugu zako mwenyewe, na watu wengine wote wa Israeli walio uhamishoni. Wamesema, "Kaeni mbali na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! Nchi hii sasa ni yetu. Tumepewa sisi."

vi.B: Hỡi con người, anh em con, chính anh em con, những người bà con có quyền chuộc con, cùng cả nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên, tất cả đều là những người mà dân Giê-ru-sa-lem đã nói về họ: "Hãy đi xa khỏi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}! Xứ này đã được ban cho chúng ta làm sản nghiệp."
